question: In the IUPAC name of a compound, the _______indicates the total number of carbon atoms present in the longest carbon chain belonging to the compound.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Root**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Root** in the IUPAC name of a compound indicates the total number of carbon atoms present in the longest carbon chain belonging to the compound.
 
• In IUPAC nomenclature, the root name is derived from the number of carbon atoms in the longest continuous chain.
